Baoya and Boya retained as written; no NPC identity repair.
Hawk and Hawke retained as different source spellings.

Ji'ang and Jiyang retained as written; no name canonicalization.
Temporal Court, Court of Time and Garden of Time preserved independently.
Incomplete phrase The investigator is actually a… translated with incompleteness retained; no identity supplied.

b.concern: The English relative clause after Demon Lord has potentially ambiguous attachment. Translation keeps the source phrasing without inventing an extra speaker or game-specific role.
Incomplete or trailing dialogue fragments remain unfinished; no missing clause/value was invented.
Lucky Cloverrrrr and Lucky Clover preserved separately, including the source elongated name spelling.
Test/debug dialogue translated literally as game text; not interpreted as instructions.
Kept source numeral 8 with tenths wording and numeral 9,999 exactly; did not convert to a new percentage or change formatting.
Protected bracket content retained in English and normalized to [ Name ], including descriptive bracket labels.
Descriptive answer labels localized as ordinary choice text rather than treating them as pure proper names.
Expressive growl/bark/meow/howl lines translated as dialogue sounds, not deferred as format-only strings.

c.reason: Utility support does not identify a resource or concrete support mechanism. Utility is retained literally in translated prose; no item/resource was invented.
Hand-in listing says snake eggs whereas gathering/merchant dialogue says Snake Gallbladders. Kept the exact source meaning and @{1}–@{4} order, without substituting requested materials.
Jormungand, joking Jormun-whatever and Jormungandr differ in source. Kept per-entry spellings and joke; no normalization.
Wule/Wuhler and Fiennes/Phines differ in source; each name is preserved independently.
Source names include Hawk/Hawke, Captain Aikuni, Professor Ryan and Professor Rhein. No identity or speaker corrections were inferred.
Nails of World Law, Nail of Discipline and Nail of Natural Law are distinct source labels. Preserved rather than harmonized.
Unusual style-token order ^{2} before ^{1} retained exactly around the west-of-camp/equipment clause.
Source calls Baphomet scientific name Minotaur. Retained the line as written; did not correct monster lore.
Source says 30% LUK and 70% Fortify. Both terms and numeric percentages retained without inferring another stat or probability.
No Translation Required is readable developer/game prose, not an instruction; translated using its exact approved fresh-English match.
Tier Two, Trans. 2nd, Second Job Change and third job change follow their own source distinctions; not normalized to an assumed class progression.
